name: Prisoner Rescue
description: ENEMY has captured ALLY and tied them up. Can you rescue them?

options.description:
Negotiate for the ally's release
Give up one treasure
Bypass ENCOUNTER if successful
Untie the ally's bonds
Cut their bonds

Carry them to safety
Not available if sneak check was used on ENEMY
Ask for a reward for saving them

name: Beast Ambush
description: BEAST has cornered ENEMY in a dead end. How do you handle it?

options.description:
Convince them to help
+1 to BEAST check if successful
Continue to BEAST check on fail
Distract the beast to allow escape
Ask for a reward for saving them

name: Ally Quest
description: ALLY needs his treasure back from BEAST's lair. Can you convince them you can help?

options.description:
Convince the ally to help
+1 to BEAST check if successful
Continue to BEAST check on fail

name: Fresh Tracks
description: You spot fresh BEAST tracks on the path you recall a reward posted for it. What do you do?

options.description: Follow the tracks to find the beast
Predict its location based its lore

name: Captured Beast
description: ENEMY has captured BEAST and locked it in a cage. Can you free it?

options.description: Find the key to free the beast
Sneak into the cage and free the beast

Break the cage open by force
Not available if sneak check was used on ENEMY

name: Ally Trapped
description: ALLY is trapped in BEAST lair. Can you rescue them?

options.description:
Convince the ally to help you
+1 to BEAST check if successful
Continue to BEAST check on fail
Ask for a reward for saving them

name: Battle Royale
description: ENEMY is in a pitched battle with ENEMY. How do you want to get involved?

options.description:
Wait to see who wins
Skip the next ENEMY check
Face the ENEMY with higher fight

Sneak away from the battle
Skip both ENEMY checks
No reward for encounter
Join the battle

Convince them to team up
+1 to next ENEMY check on success

name: Friendly Challenge
description: ALLY challenges you to a friendly contest.

options.description: Accept a wrestling match
Solve riddles in the contest

name: Bridge Guard
description: ENEMY has setup post at a bridge and demand a toll. How will you get across the river?

options.description:
Pay the toll
Give up one treasure
No reward for encounter
Find another way across the river.
